DEV_acceptance.PASS_meaning: DEV mechanism diagnostic only, no confirmation/promotion/official claim; one document cluster, no independent-document CI
DEV_acceptance.other: all51 complete, errors0, NotMentioned fullcoverage, actual runtime<=600,CPU2,genuine native; labels only after source freeze/forecasts/processclosure

aggregation.NotMentioned: Only after ALL supplied windows. Native missing/incomplete hitlist forces complete source-order fallback with early exit disabled.
aggregation.early_exit: native/source only, after all actual same-state windows in a batch; E or C support>=log9 AND margin over opposite>=log3; no numeric flags; full reference never exits
aggregation.numeric_policy: Only claim numeric literals flag; exact comma-stripped/+stripped lexical token set diagnostic. Any flag disables early exit, never changes logits or decision. Context-only numbered clauses do not flag.
aggregation.probabilities: untempered stable double softmax [C,E,N], no clipping/fitting/renormalization

batch1.gate: Independent genuine native/count/resource/IO audit plus 2*ceil(3*17*W/8)*max(full8_forward_seconds)+measured_modelinit_total+90 <=420. Hash+tokenizer+ORT initialization included measured_modelinit_total; no retries.

batch2.Gold_access: Only after all51forecasts sealed and all owned processes/PG/SIDs independently physically closed; no selection after labels.
batch2.conditional_on: Independent accepted batch1 and frozen projection<=420

batching: Roundrobin active case-arm states: one next window per state per rotation, fill8, revisit if fewer8active states. Same actual minibatch head for all arms, no cached/replayed arm outputs. Decision only after actual current batch consumed. All NLI inputs padded512; lastbatch<=8. Full-coverage bound ceil(3*17*W/8).

forward_accounting.per_case_actual_model_forward_calls: Shared-batch participations of that case-arm, never sum as global physicalcalls.

latency_semantics: Per-state elapsed first submitted batch start through decision, including interbatch queue+tokenization/forward; excludes wait before firstsubmit. Report p50/p95 as batched mechanism latency; wholeCLI actual dominant; no singlequery deployment speedclaim.

raw_DEV_archival.purpose: Independent typed-max-logodds/early-exit/coverage replay for all51forecasts; no cache/replayed outputs or extra forwards.
raw_DEV_archival.timing: Input/output hashing and durable per-batch output archival excluded only from measured session.run forwardseconds; included wholeCLI and case decision elapsed.

shared_catalog.before_final_source_freeze: Separately admitted blind DATA/tokenizer-only actual W+catalog SHA frozen; no model/native/Gold.
shared_catalog.method: Exact contiguous source-unit partition. Oversized units deterministic largest-fitting binary-search codepoint prefix; adjacent fragments greedily merge only if ALL17 NLI pair encodings and whole BGE window fit<=512. No hidden truncation, no labels/model logits. Source blank units attached to preceding fragment; inability to fit or W>24 fails closed.
